info.name: Workday Payroll Input Deductions Pay Runs API
info.description:
API for submitting and managing payroll input data within the Workday platform, including one-time payments, payroll adjustments, supplemental earnings, and batch input submissions.

Contact Support:

 Email: support@workday.com
